title: A Party Invitation
text:
Maria is having a party on Friday evening. She sends an invitation to her friends. The invitation says the party starts at seven o'clock. Maria's house is near the park.

Leo gets the invitation on Wednesday. He is happy and says yes. He wants to bring a cake for Maria. He asks his mother to help him buy it.

questions.text: When does Leo get the invitation?
What can we guess about Leo?
options: He wants to go to the party
He does not want to eat cake
He is not allowed to go out

questions.text: Why does Leo ask his mother for help?
options: He wants to buy a cake for Maria
He wants to cancel the party
He does not know where Maria lives
He wants to go to the park

vocabulary.definition: a card or message that asks someone to come to an event
a social event where people meet, eat and have fun together
a sweet food made from flour, eggs and sugar, often for special days
feeling good because something nice has happened

paragraph_translations: У Марії в п'ятницю ввечері вечірка. Вона надсилає запрошення своїм друзям. У запрошенні написано, що вечірка починається о сьомій годині. Будинок Марії стоїть біля парку.
Лео отримує запрошення в середу. Він радий і каже так. Він хоче принести торт для Марії. Він просить маму допомогти йому його купити.
